append.text: **Ps 50:3b** *segundo a multidão das vossas compaixões* (beside *misericórdia* in 3a, ἔλεος / οἰκτιρμοί); the stylist heard the plural as translated and proposed *clemências* — refused for this row, kept as an option.
**Ps 50:4, 50:9 applied**: *purificai-me do meu pecado*, *e serei purificado*, echoing *coração puro* (50:12 *cor mundum*); *limpar* not needed. The three readers passed it.
**Ps 50:10 applied**: *Ao meu ouvido dareis júbilo e alegria* (also the Matins versicle); passed the Latinist twice.
**Ps 50:21 applied** *bezerros*, not the local *novilhos*: *então sobre o vosso altar porão bezerros* (the stylist's order, so *porão* is not heard as the noun; ends on the victims as the Latin).
**Ps 50:13** *Não me lanceis para longe da vossa face* (as 2:3; the pencilled *lanceis da vossa face* kept as option).

**Ps 50:14** *e firmai-me com um espírito soberano* (στήρισον): with a person as object *confirmai-me* is heard as the sacrament; *firmar* taken, passed the readers. Proposal: *firmar* whenever a person is the object.

**Ps 50:15** *e os ímpios se converterão a vós*: D25's exception (men turning to God → *converter*) extended from the imperative to the promise; *se voltarão para vós* option. Passed the Latinist twice.

**Ps 50:19 departs: *não desprezareis*** — *despícies* is ἐξουθενώσει, the Greek of 21:25's *sprevit → desprezou* (D15's test), not 9:22's ὑπερορᾷς; the Friday Lauds antiphon *Cor contrítum … non despícies*. The row should split by the Greek: ἐξουδενόω/ἐξουθενόω → desprezar.

**Ps 50:14 *Redde mihi* 'give back' (ἀπόδος) → *Devolvei-me*** (a sense apart from paying): *Restituí-me* D13-legal but heard as 'I restored' at the head of a Preces versicle; *Tornai a dar-me*, *Dai-me* (MS1932) options.
Ps 50:16 applied *Livrai-me do sangue*; the Latinist asked for *dos sangues* at both reads — refused by this ruling; the ambiguity reader heard bloodshed rather than bloodguilt either way.
**Ps 50:19** *cor contrítum* → *coração contrito* (the sacramental word; beside *contribulátus → atribulado*).
Ps 50:21 applied: *as oferendas e os holocaustos*.
Ps 50:3a *Tende piedade de mim, Deus* (bare vocative, as the psalter; *ó Deus* kept as option).

terms: | principális (*spíritu principáli*) | soberano (*e firmai-me com um espírito soberano*) | open | Ps 50:14 (ἡγεμονικῷ, 'ruling'); *principal* means only 'main'; options *de príncipe*, *magnânimo* (MS1932), *generoso* (the Hebrew, refused). The ambiguity reader heard God's own sovereign spirit — a patristic reading the Latin allows; one blind reader listed *soberano* as unknown. |

| contribuláre (*spíritus contribulátus*) | atribulado (*Sacrifício a Deus é um espírito atribulado*) | open | Ps 50:19 (συντετριμμένον); kept apart from *contrítum → contrito* in the next colon; *quebrantado* (quebranto) and *compungido* (compúngere's) options. The ambiguity reader noted the everyday *atribulado* = 'hectic'; kept. |

| incértus (*incérta et occúlta*) | incerto (*as coisas incertas e ocultas da vossa sabedoria*) | open | Ps 50:8 (ἄδηλα); neuter plural → *coisas* supplied (as 16:14b); *obscuras* option. The ambiguity reader: *incertas* may sound 'doubtful'; *ocultas* steers it. |
| víscera | entranhas (*renovai nas minhas entranhas um espírito reto*) | open | Ps 50:12; the organ kept (MS1932 *entranhas*, DRB 'bowels'); one blind reader listed it as unknown. |

| ámplius (degree: *Ámplius lava me*) | ainda mais (*Lavai-me ainda mais da minha iniquidade*) | open | Ps 50:4 (ἐπὶ πλεῖον; DRB 'yet more'); *mais e mais* (MS1932) option; kept apart from *ámplius non* → *já não* (38:14). |

| dealbári (*super nivem dealbábor*) | ficar mais branco (*e ficarei mais branco que a neve*) | open | Ps 50:9; *ficar* + adjective as the resultative of the passive. The Latinist asked twice for the passive (*serei branqueado*, *serei alvejado*): refused — laundry/bleach and 'shot at'; kept as options. |

| benígne fácere (*Benígne fac … Sion*) | tratar benignamente (*Tratai benignamente, Senhor, a Sião, na vossa boa vontade*) | open | Ps 50:20 (ἀγάθυνον); the Latinist's fix, as 118:124 *Fac cum servo tuo → Tratai o vosso servo*; v1 *Sede benigno … com Sião* option. |
| impónere super | pôr sobre (*então sobre o vosso altar porão bezerros*) | open | Ps 50:21; the place first so *porão* is not heard as the noun 'hold, basement'; *colocarão* option. |
| contra me (ἐνώπιον: *peccátum meum contra me est semper*) | diante de mim | open | Ps 50:5 (DRB 'before me', MS1932); *contra mim* is heard only as hostility. |
| audítus (the hearing) | ouvido (*Ao meu ouvido dareis júbilo e alegria*) | open | Ps 50:10; the Latin build kept against DM1962 *Faze-me ouvir*. |

| hyssópus | hissopo (*Vós me aspergireis com o hissopo*) | open | Ps 50:9 (MS1932 *hissope*, older spelling); one blind reader listed *hissopo* and *aspergireis* as unknown — the Asperges words, kept. |

| delectári (deponent: *holocáustis non delectáberis*) | deleitar-se (*com holocaustos não vos deleitareis*) | open | Ps 50:18 (εὐδοκήσεις), as 36:4 *Deleita-te no Senhor*; the causative delectáre at 29:2 went to *alegrar* (εὐφραίνω). The same Greek is *acceptábis → aceitareis* in 50:21: the Latin's two verbs kept two. |

| exsultáre + accusative (*exsultábit lingua mea justítiam tuam*) | exultar em (*a minha língua exultará na vossa justiça*) | open | Ps 50:16; *exultar* takes no object in Portuguese (12:6b, 34:9 have *em*). The Latinist asked twice for the object (*exultará a vossa justiça*; *exaltará com júbilo a vossa justiça*); held, both kept as options. |

| spíritus sanctus tuus (50:13) | o vosso espírito santo (lower case) | open | Ps 50:13; lower case as the DO Latin prints it, beside *espírito reto* (12) and *soberano* (14); the Person is heard anyway (the ambiguity reader); *Espírito Santo* option. |
